test_find_adaptive_state: test the _find_adaptive_state function to extract adaptive optimizer state from optax optimizers like adam, adamw, rmsprop, adagrad, and amsgrad
test_scale_then_privatize_init: test scale_then_privatize wraps an optax optimizer and produces matching initial state on initialization
test_pre_clipping_transform: test pre_clipping_transform applies coordinate-wise scaling using 1/(sqrt(nu) + eps) to precondition gradients before clipping
test_update_applies_inverse: test the update method applies inverse preconditioning internally so scaled gradients produce identical updates to unscaled ones
test_custom_preconditioner_fn: test scale_then_privatize accepts a custom extract_preconditioner_from_state_fn to provide per-coordinate scaling for non-adaptive optimizers like sgd
